label: s2_side01_0000_friend_02
text: I heard the news. You’ve been having all kinds\nof big adventures, huh, little buddy?\r\nSchool trips, studying abroad... What luck![VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: s2_side01_0000_select_01
text: Yeah, it’s been awesome!

label: s2_side01_0000_select_02
text: Oh, it’s not that big of a deal...

label: s2_side01_0000_friend_03
text: Yeah? Man, I’m jealous to hear that. I wish I\ncould’ve gone along too![VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: s2_side01_0000_friend_04
text: Are you kidding me?! Man, acting like this kinda\nthing’s normal. What a world traveler![VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: s2_side01_0000_friend_05
text: Now that I think about it, it’s been one crazy\nthing after another since you came to our school.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: s2_side01_0000_friend_06
text: I guess you’ve still been real busy lately, but are\nthings starting to settle down?[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: s2_side01_0000_friend_07
text: I was thinking that if you have time—and only\nif you want, ’course—maybe...[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: s2_side01_0000_friend_08
text: I could come visit you at your house?[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: s2_side01_0000_select_03
text: Of course! Come right over!

label: s2_side01_0000_select_04
text: Is something wrong?

label: s2_side01_0000_friend_09
text: Seriously?! It’s such a relief to hear you say that!\nAnd without even the tiniest hesitation![VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: s2_side01_0000_friend_10
text: Nah, nothing like that! I just thought, you know,\nfriends...go to each other’s houses and stuff?[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: s2_side01_0000_friend_11
text: So I guess I’ll come over![VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: s2_side01_0000_friend_12
text: Your house is in Cabo Poco, right?[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: s2_side01_0000_friend_13
text: I’ll meet you out front! See you there![VAR 0x0114(0006)]
